checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Presenter remains recognizably the grey-haired man
must.why: Face, hair, shirt and kitchen match the photo across all frames.

must.item: Audible coherent agent-written English line inviting viewers to check out the sale
must.why: Audio not heard. The stated script is a coherent sale invitation, and the voice has sound.

must.item: No invented discount, date, product or specific offer
must.why: The stated script is generic and has no specifics.

must.item: Mouth visibly moves in sync with speech
must.why: The mouth is open and shaped differently in the mid frames and closed at the end. Precise sync can't be judged without audio.

must.item: One square 8-second video, friendly male voice, no captions
must.why: The frames are square and have no captions. The voice is described as male. The clip is 8 s, but the line may run past 8 s and get cut off.

faults.what: The closing line may be clipped at 8 s. The agent admitted it did not check the length of the spoken line.
Slight head and face movement and mild softness at 480p.

summary: A clean, square 8-second talking video of the same man with natural mouth movement and no captions. The only risk is that the last words are cut off, since the line length was not checked.
